import os

from openai import Client

client = Client(
    api_key=os.environ.get("OPENAI_API_KEY"),
)

result = client.admin.organization.projects.rate_limits.update_rate_limit("project_id", "rate_limit_id", max_requests_per_1_minute=1, max_tokens_per_1_minute=1, max_images_per_1_minute=1, max_audio_megabytes_per_1_minute=1, max_requests_per_1_day=1, batch_1_day_max_input_tokens=1)
print(result)
